purpose: Stage 3 ideal synchronized RGB stereo functional proxy; not a physical camera calibration
coordinate_convention: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up; optical images are pinhole projections

stereo.calibration_status: ideal pinhole generated from configured FOV and resolution; no real-device calibration claimed

interpretation.sensor_model: two ideal RGB pinhole cameras with global same-render-frame sampling; not Gemini SDK, IR, sensor noise or rolling shutter
interpretation.public_semantics: same central FrontCamera RGB view is saved for every scenario and is not substituted by a stereo view
interpretation.ground_truth: Isaac distance_to_image_plane geometric depth annotator saved separately and used only by evaluation; never read by matcher
interpretation.depth_convention: stereo estimate is metric optical-axis Z in meters; invalid values remain NaN with a separate mask
